description: Stripe payment integration for token purchases, navigation bar, and dashboard enhancements

userStories.title: Install Stripe dependencies and create client
userStories.description: As a developer, I need Stripe client setup to enable payment processing.
acceptanceCriteria: Install stripe and @stripe/stripe-js packages
Create lib/stripe.ts with Stripe client initialized
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Create pricing page with token pack options
userStories.description: As a user, I want to view token pack prices and purchase options.
acceptanceCriteria: Create app/pricing/page.tsx
Display 3 token pack options (10, 50, 100 tokens) with pricing
Each pack has 'Buy Now' button that calls checkout API
Show current token balance for logged-in users
Typecheck passes
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill

userStories.title: Create Stripe checkout API route
userStories.description: As a user, I need a checkout session to purchase tokens.
acceptanceCriteria: Create app/api/checkout/route.ts POST endpoint
Accept token_pack_id and tokens_quantity in request body
Validate user is authenticated
Create Stripe Checkout Session with metadata (user_id, tokens)
Return checkout URL for redirect
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Create Stripe webhook handler route
userStories.description: As the system, I need to process successful payments and add tokens.
acceptanceCriteria: Create app/api/webhooks/stripe/route.ts POST endpoint
Verify Stripe webhook signature
Handle checkout.session.completed event
Extract user_id and tokens from event metadata
Insert record into token_purchases table with status='completed'
Update profiles.token_balance by adding purchased tokens
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Add purchase history to dashboard
userStories.description: As a user, I want to see my token purchase history.
acceptanceCriteria: Fetch token_purchases for current user in dashboard
Display list of recent purchases (date, tokens, amount, status)
Add 'Purchase History' section below token balance card
Typecheck passes
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill

userStories.title: Create navbar component with auth state
userStories.description: As a user, I want navigation with login/logout functionality.
acceptanceCriteria: Create components/Navbar.tsx client component
Show 'Login' button when user is not authenticated
Show user avatar and dropdown menu when authenticated
Dropdown includes: Dashboard, Sign Out
Add logo or app name on left side
Typecheck passes
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill

userStories.title: Integrate navbar into layout
userStories.description: As a user, I want navigation to be visible on all pages.
acceptanceCriteria: Import Navbar component in app/layout.tsx
Place Navbar at top of layout above children
Navbar spans full width with proper styling
Typecheck passes
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill

userStories.title: Add generation history to dashboard
userStories.description: As a user, I want to see my recent meme generations.
acceptanceCriteria: Create app/api/user/generations/route.ts GET endpoint
Fetch generations table filtered by current user_id
Order by created_at DESC (most recent first)
Return generations with template_name, topic, created_at, tokens_spent
Display generation history list in dashboard
Each row shows: date, template, topic, tokens spent
